  V.transpose * V = 1 →

        (A * V * Matrix.diagonal c * V.transpose).mulVec x ⬝ᵥ (A * V * Matrix.diagonal c * V.transpose).mulVec x =
          ∑ i, c i ^ 2 * lam i * V.transpose.mulVec x i ^ 2
